---
title: "About"
---

Astronomical Intelligence is an open collection of tested workflows for doing research with language models, started by astronomers and open to every field.

The site is independent of any AI company. Models are named because results depend on them, not as endorsements.

Text is released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) and code under the [MIT licence](https://opensource.org/license/mit).

## Privacy

The site uses no cookies. Visits are counted with [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com), an open-source service that does not track visitors across sites and does not store personal data. The fonts are served from this site, so no requests go to third-party font services.
